title: Jurassic flightless bird reveals early ecological diversity of avialans
title_zh: 侏罗飞不了的鸟揭示早期鸟形类的生态多样性
abstract: The origin and early diversification of birds remain highly debated in vertebrate evolution. Although estimates of the evolutionary timescales suggest a Jurassic period radiation1,2, a profound scarcity of fossils from this period has hampered how the distinctive bird bauplan was assembled3-5. Selection for powered flight has been viewed as the primary driver of early avialan skeletal modifications3,6,7, attesting to the independent occurrences of aerodynamic features among paravian lineages8. Here we report on the discovery of a Late Jurassic avialan, Yuezhuornis yangyuanensis, gen. et sp. nov., from the Zhenghe Fauna of southeastern China9. As one of the earliest diverging avialans, Y. yangyuanensis exhibits a striking mosaic of features, combining a mixture of avialan- and troodontid-like cranial characters, paired with derived postcranial traits and a deinonychosaur-like hyperextensible second pedal digit. Phylogenetically informed analyses show that Y. yangyuanensis possesses markedly short forelimbs-a condition present widely among non-avialan theropods. These findings provide strong evidence for a terrestrial, flightless lifestyle of Y. yangyuanensis. Our study demonstrates that evolution works intensively as exemplified by the occurrence of several, divergent ecological pathways being exploited in the initial diversification of birds.
abstract_zh: 鸟类的起源及早期辐射仍是脊椎动物进化中争议极大的课题。尽管进化时间尺度的估计表明始新世/侏罗纪早期有辐射1,2，但该时期化石的严重匮乏阻碍了我们了解典型鸟形体如何组装3-5。人们曾认为，对有力飞行的选择是早期鸟形类骨骼修饰的主要驱动力3,6,7，这证明了空气动力特征在鸟形类近缘线中独立出现8。在此，我们报告从中国东南部郑何动物群发现的始新世/侏罗纪晚期鸟形类Yuezhuornis yangyuanensis，属及种新9。作为早期分化的鸟形类，Y. yangyuanensis呈现出显著的 mosaic 特征，将鸟形类和近鸟龙类的头骨特征相结合，并具有衍生的躯干特征以及类似近爪龙的可弯曲第二足趾。系统发育信息分析显示，Y. yangyuanensis 具有明显短小的前肢——这一状态在非鸟形类恐龙中普遍存在。这些发现为 Y. yangyuanensis 的陆生、不会飞的生活方式提供了有力证据。我们的研究展示了进化的强烈体现：在鸟类初始辐射期间，出现了多条不同的生态途径被利用。
